svg.title: Gall's law
svg.desc: Left: a ticketing site switches from its old monolith to 14 new services in one night. At 10:00 parts start failing at once, nobody can tell which one is wrong, 6,000 fans see errors, and at 10:40 traffic rolls back. Right: a proxy moves seat holds to one new service in month 1 and checkout in month 4 while the monolith shrinks, and the system works at every step.
svg.text: 14 untested parts went live at once and failed. One slice at a time works.
